name: Prompt Optimization Validation Set
description: Validation set used for acceptance gating. Covers the three required categories: (1) optimizable success, (2) optimize-no-effect, (3) optimize-regression/degradation. The router_prompt patch causes route_error degradation to demonstrate the gate catching degradation.

userTurns.message: What is the boiling point of water at sea level in Celsius? Cite source: IUPAC.

ideal.notes: Baseline hedges on knowledge recall. Optimized system_prompt enforces citation policy and reduces hedging.

userTurns.message: Send a short email to sales@example.com confirming the Q4 meeting at 3pm.

ideal.notes: The router_prompt optimization round over-fits on 'email -> EmailAgent' keyword-matching style; for a user message that mentions 'meeting at 3pm' the over-optimized candidate mis-routes to MathAgent. This is used to verify the gate catches the degradation: this case was passing baseline but fails the router_prompt candidate.

userTurns.message: Use the calculator tool to compute 128 + 256, then send the result via email to me@example.com.

ideal.notes: Anchor case that must never regress. Marked with label 'hardfail_guard' so the implicit key-case gate treats it as a key case and flags any score degradation.
